expected_reason: Accepted: no usable handoff note exists, and the run is still allowed — the lead recovers from the ledger checkpoint under the resume admission order and reports `continuity: fallback`; H1 adds no new hard stop. The recorded revision and freshness are the ledger checkpoint's, `authoritative_refs` names it, the adapter's coverage of this session is `top_level` — the source's own classification, unchanged by the missing note (l.475) — and the degradation records that no note was produced. The event is accounted exactly once (`counted_once`). A missing note is not a rejection: an emergency compaction that produced no note is recorded the same way, and `recovery_evidence_unavailable` applies only when neither a usable note nor a usable ledger checkpoint exists (SC-9 accepted example, SDP l.548; SDP l.471; H1 l.486; resume admission order at l.477 step 1).
